name: Movement and look
goalName: Implement player movement (WASD) and looking around (mouse)
goal: Standard PC controls allow the player to move using the WASD keys. They are also commonly able to use the mouse to operate the camera.

approach.text: <<source Class PlayerInput | Input System | 1.0.2. (n.d.). Docs.Unity3d.Com. Retrieved September 23, 2021, from https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.inputsystem@1.0/api/UnityEngine.InputSystem.PlayerInput.html>>

result: As seen in the video below, the player is able to move and look around without the z rotation changing (this was a major issue). Also, the player object (a cylinder) does not tip over when moving (second major issue).<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/4nRdhO5sT_Y>>
validation: After showing my (with contribution from my teammate) to the other teammate, he found the solution very good.
contribution: Now the movement and looking around mechanics are finished (for now), I will work on lasers. Lasers will be covered in another entry.
